stories.title: US sanctions Indian and Turkish entities for aiding Iran
stories.summary: The U.S. Treasury announced sanctions targeting several Indian and Turkish firms and individuals accused of facilitating Iran’s oil sales. The measures are part of the Trump administration’s “Operation Economic Outcast,” intended to limit Iran’s ability to fund its conflict with the United States and Israel. The announcement came a day after Democrats secured control of both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections, amid public concern over the Iran war and inflation.
stories.why: The sanctions aim to cut off Iran’s oil revenue, increasing pressure on its war financing and reflecting a U.S. policy response aligned with recent domestic political shifts.
